opportunities.title: FY27 Renewal - FJC Immigration Legal Services
opportunities.agency: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
opportunities.summary: The Department of Social Services/Human Resources Administration is renewing a contract for FJC immigration legal services to provide assistance to its client population. The award will be executed under a renewal procurement vehicle.

opportunities.title: FY27 Renewal - FJC Immigration Legal Center
opportunities.agency: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
opportunities.vendor: New York Legal Assistance Group Inc.
opportunities.summary: The Department of Social Services and the Office of Civil Justice, together with the Mayor’s Office to End Domestic and Gender-Based Violence, are renewing a contract to provide trauma‑informed immigration‑related legal services at the city’s five Family Justice Centers. The services include legal screening, advice, representation before immigration agencies and courts, and assistance with pro se filings for survivors of domestic and gender‑based violence and their children. The work is funded through a renewal award vehicle under the Human Services/Client Services category.

opportunities.title: The Arches program, which targets high-crime neighborhoods. Procurement is for human client services, as such Competitive Sealed Proposals is the most appropriate source selection method. E jy17 ARCHE
opportunities.summary: The agency is procuring human client services for the Arches program in high‑crime neighborhoods (awarded to Youth Justice Network) and permanent supportive congregate housing and related services for HIV/AIDS clients with mental health or substance‑use needs (awarded to Harlem United Community AIDS Center), as well as Family Justice Center immigration legal services (awarded to Sanctuary for). All contracts are being awarded under Competitive Sealed Proposals.

opportunities.title: In-Person/VRI interpretation for Spoken Languages Services
opportunities.summary: The NYC Administration for Children’s Services is awarding three contracts, via competitive sealed proposals, for in‑person and video remote interpretation of spoken languages, Deaf/Hard‑of‑Hearing interpretation, language services, and written translation, to support limited‑English proficient and deaf/hard‑of‑hearing families from July 1 2026 through June 30 2029.

opportunities.title: Deaf/Hard-of-Hearing Language Access Services
opportunities.summary: The Administration for Children’s Services (ACS) Immigrant Services and Language Affairs division is procuring a vendor to provide sign language interpretation services, including in‑person, on‑site, and on‑demand video remote interpretation for ASL, Certified Deaf Interpretation, foreign sign languages, and CART. The services will support ACS and its provider network in serving limited‑English proficient and deaf/hard‑of‑hearing families to meet statutory accessibility requirements. The contract will be awarded via a competitive sealed proposals process and will run from July 1 2026 through June 30 2029.

opportunities.title: Translation Services
opportunities.summary: The Administration for Children’s Services is awarding up to three contracts to provide in‑person and video‑remote interpretation for spoken languages, Deaf/Hard‑of‑Hearing interpretation, and written translation services. The services will support ACS and its provider network in serving limited‑English proficient and deaf/hard‑of‑hearing families, and will be awarded through a competitive sealed‑proposal process for a term from July 1 2026 through June 30 2029.

opportunities.title: FY27 Renewal - NYCitizenship Program
opportunities.agency: Dept. of Social Svcs/Human Resources Administration
opportunities.vendor: New York Legal Assistance Group Inc.
opportunities.summary: The Department of Social Services/Human Resources Administration is renewing a contract to provide legal screenings and services to participants in the NYCitizenship Program, offering free assistance through the naturalization process. The work is performed under the FY27 Renewal vehicle in the Human Services/Client Services category.

opportunities.title: Outside Land Use & Zoning Counsel with respect to the Science Park & Research Campus (SPARC) Kips Bay Project
opportunities.address: One Liberty Plaza, 165 Broadway, 14th Floor Mailroom, New York, NY 10006
opportunities.summary: The New York City Economic Development Corporation is soliciting proposals from law firms and lawyers to serve as outside legal counsel. The services will include analyzing, drafting, and reviewing applications for tax lot apportionments and zoning lot subdivisions for Manhattan Tax Block 962, part of Lot 100, to support the Science Park & Research Campus (SPARC) Kips Bay development and related building permit filings. Selections will be made based on the criteria outlined in the Request for Proposals.
